column1: Supplementary Table S2. Full search-space evaluation of the 40 preprocessing–binning configurations for PLSR predicting the source-defined Cp trait (g cm?2) from canopy-level hyperspectral reflectance in Dataset 13 (n=305). Each configuration was applied uniformly across the five outer folds (fixed-configuration landscape), and configurations are ranked by mean outer-fold RPD. Columns report the median number of latent components selected within the inner cross-validation loops, the mean and standard deviation across the five outer folds for each predictive metric, and the approximate 95% interval half-width for RPD (1.96×SD/5). These values describe the performance of each configuration when evaluated under a common protocol and are distinct from the per-fold nested selections reported in Supplementary Table S1, where the configuration and number of components were selected separately within each outer-training subset.
